澳洲冰箱品牌新品监控 - 每日自动检查任务：

**基线数据：** 读取 `data/au-fridge-baseline-2026-06-15.md` 获取上次记录的产品清单。

**抓取阶段：** 对以下 5 个品牌页面分别用 firecrawl_scrape 抓取（formats: ["json"], 每个页面单独调用）：
1. 海信 Hisense: https://hisense.com.au/appliances/fridges-freezers/all （提取所有产品型号和名称）
2. 美的 Midea: https://www.midea.com/au/refrigerator （提取所有产品型号和名称）
3. 三星 Samsung: https://www.samsung.com/au/refrigerators/ （如 JS 动态页面无法完整抓取，改用 bocha_web_search 搜索 "Samsung Australia new refrigerator 2026 site:samsung.com/au"）
4. LG: LG 官网有反爬保护，改用 bocha_web_search 搜索 "LG Australia new fridge 2026 site:lg.com/au" 和 "LG Australia refrigerator models"
5. 西屋 Westinghouse: https://www.westinghouse.com.au/fridges-and-freezers （提取所有冰箱子品类链接和型号）

**对比分析：**
- 将本次抓取的型号与基线数据逐一对比
- 重点关注：
  a. 是否有之前基线中不存在的全新型号？
  b. 美的 MDRT580MTF45AP (413L) 是否从 "Coming Soon" 变为可购买状态？
  c. 海信是否有新增 "New" 标签的型号？
  d. 各品牌是否有新增冰箱子品类？

**发送阶段 - 飞书通知：**
1. 如果发现任何变化，通过飞书 Webhook 发送通知
2. Webhook URL: https://open.feishu.cn/open-apis/bot/v2/hook/608c82a6-6355-4bcb-b0b0-5c097602d2c9
3. 使用 Python requests 发送 msg_type="interactive" 卡片消息
4. 卡片标题："🔔 澳洲冰箱新品监控日报 - {当天日期}"
5. 蓝色模板，分品牌展示变化情况
6. 如无任何变化，也发送一条简短卡片："今日 5 品牌均无新品上架或状态变更"
7. 卡片底部标注："由 Incaier Agent 自动监控 | 下次检查：明早 9:07"

**更新基线：** 如有变化，更新 `data/au-fridge-baseline-2026-06-15.md` 文件中的产品清单。

1→# FireCrawl网页解析
     2→
     3→Firecrawl MCP Server 是一个基于 Model Context Protocol 的网页抓取与搜索服务，为 AI Agent 提供实时网页内容获取能力。支持单页抓取、批量抓取、整站爬取、网页搜索、站点地图发现、结构化数据提取、自主研究Agent以及页面变更监控等核心功能，可将任意网页转化为 Agent 可用的干净、结构化上下文数据。
     4→
     5→## Scope
     6→
     7→能力市场提供的 MCP 服务。
     8→
     9→## Authentication
    10→
    11→此 MCP 服务通过 `X-Platform-Access-Key` 请求头进行认证，凭证已自动配置。
    12→
    13→- **Header Name:** `X-Platform-Access-Key`
    14→- **Access Key:** `pk_b1fb70c791093782097c3405bb9854cd18cccfe520714fa89932b20f8239f625`
    15→
    16→## Guidelines
    17→
    18→- 传输协议: Streamable_HTTP
    19→- 此服务由能力市场平台代理，认证凭证已自动配置
    20→- 会话超时: 1440 分钟
    21→
    22→## Documentation
    23→
    24→## 概述
    25→
    26→Firecrawl MCP Server 是由 Firecrawl 官方推出的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）服务器，为兼容 MCP 协议的 AI Agent（如 Cursor、Claude Desktop、VS Code、Windsurf 等）提供强大的网页抓取与搜索能力。它将 Firecrawl 的网页处理能力通过标准化的 MCP 协议暴露给 AI Agent，使 Agent 能够自主地搜索、抓取、交互和分析实时网页内容。
    27→
    28→## 核心工具
    29→
    30→#### 1. 单页抓取（firecrawl_scrape）
    31→
    32→抓取指定 URL 的页面内容，支持多种输出格式：
    33→
    34→- **JSON 格式（推荐）**：通过 Schema 定义精确提取所需字段，保持响应精简，避免上下文窗口溢出
    35→- **Markdown 格式**：输出完整页面内容，适用于文章阅读或页面结构分析
    36→- **Branding 格式**：提取品牌标识信息（颜色、字体、排版、间距、Logo、UI 组件等）
    37→
    38→支持 PII 脱敏（设置 `redactPII: true`），自动过滤个人敏感信息。
    39→
    40→#### 2. 批量抓取（firecrawl_batch_scrape）
    41→
    42→高效并行抓取多个已知 URL，内置限流与队列管理：
    43→
    44→- 支持异步处理，返回操作 ID
    45→- 通过 `firecrawl_check_batch_status` 查询处理进度
    46→- 自动处理限流与重试
    47→
    48→#### 3. 网页搜索（firecrawl_search）
    49→
    50→根据关键词搜索互联网并可选抓取搜索结果页面内容：
    51→
    52→- 支持语言（`lang`）和地区（`country`）筛选
    53→- 可通过 `scrapeOptions` 配置搜索结果页面的抓取选项
    54→- 支持 PII 脱敏
    55→- 搜索后可通过 `firecrawl_search_feedback` 提交反馈，退还 1 积分并提升搜索质量
    56→
    57→#### 4. 站点地图（firecrawl_map）
    58→
    59→发现并列出网站上所有已索引的 URL：
    60→
    61→- 适用于在抓取前了解站点结构
    62→- 帮助定位网站特定板块
    63→- 返回 URL 数组，可配合 batch_scrape 使用
    64→
    65→#### 5. 整站爬取（firecrawl_crawl）
    66→
    67→异步爬取整个网站或指定目录下的所有页面内容：
    68→
    69→- 支持深度限制（`maxDepth`）和页面数量限制（`limit`）
    70→- 支持去重（`deduplicateSimilarURLs`）和外链控制（`allowExternalLinks`）
    71→- 通过 `firecrawl_check_crawl_status` 查询爬取进度
    72→- 适用于需要全面覆盖的多页面内容提取场景
    73→
    74→#### 6. 结构化数据提取（firecrawl_extract）
    75→
    76→利用 LLM 能力从多个页面中提取符合 JSON Schema 的结构化数据：
    77→
    78→- 支持自定义 Prompt 和系统提示词
    79→- 支持 JSON Schema 定义输出结构
    80→- 可选启用 Web 搜索获取额外上下文
    81→- 支持子域名包含和外链控制
    82→- 云端使用 Firecrawl 托管 LLM，自托管使用本地配置的 LLM
    83→
    84→#### 7. 自主研究 Agent（firecrawl_agent）
    85→
    86→自主浏览互联网、搜索信息、导航页面并提取结构化数据的 AI Agent 层：
    87→
    88→- 异步工作流：提交任务后返回 Job ID，通过 `firecrawl_agent_status` 轮询获取结果
    89→- 支持自然语言描述研究目标
    90→- 可指定 URL 范围聚焦研究
    91→- 适用于复杂的多源研究任务
    92→- 研究过程可能持续数分钟，适合异步处理
    93→
    94→#### 8. 页面变更监控（firecrawl_monitor_*）
    95→
    96→创建定时监控任务，对指定页面进行周期性抓取和差异比对：
    97→
    98→- `firecrawl_monitor_create`：创建监控，支持单页/多页、自定义目标（Goal）、Webhook 通知
    99→- `firecrawl_monitor_list`：列出所有监控
   100→- `firecrawl_monitor_get`：获取单个监控详情
   101→- `firecrawl_monitor_update`：更新监控配置
   102→- `firecrawl_monitor_run`：手动触发一次检查
   103→- `firecrawl_monitor_checks`：列出检查历史
   104→- `firecrawl_monitor_check`：获取页面级别的差异、快照和 AI 判断结果
   105→
   106→支持 AI 智能判断变更是否有意义（设置 `goal` 后自动启用），减少噪音告警。
   107→
   108→#### 9. 页面交互（interact）
   109→
   110→对已抓取的页面进行交互式浏览器自动化操作：
   111→
   112→- 支持点击、导航、输入等操作
   113→- 适用于需要登录后才能获取内容的场景
   114→
   115→## 技术特性
   116→
   117→| 特性 | 说明 |
   118→|------|------|
   119→| 自动重试 | 支持指数退避策略，自动处理限流和瞬时错误 |
   120→| 额度监控 | 跟踪 API 积分消耗，在阈值处发出警告和严重告警 |
   121→| 部署方式 | 支持云端 API 和自托管实例 |
   122→| 传输协议 | 支持 stdio、SSE、Streamable HTTP 多种传输方式 |
   123→| 认证方式 | 支持 API Key 和 MCP OAuth（Bearer Token） |
   124→| 日志系统 | 完善的操作状态、性能指标、错误条件日志 |
   125→| 限流处理 | 自动限流处理、智能请求队列和节流 |
   126→| 批量处理 | 高效并行处理，支持异步状态查询 |
   127→
   128→## 工具选择指南
   129→
   130→| 场景 | 推荐工具 | 说明 |
   131→|------|----------|------|
   132→| 知道确切 URL，抓取单个页面 | scrape | 使用 JSON 格式提取结构化数据 |
   133→| 知道确切 URL，抓取多个页面 | batch_scrape | 批量并行处理 |
   134→| 不知道 URL，需要发现站点页面 | map | 先发现 URL，再配合 scrape/batch_scrape |
   135→| 搜索互联网获取信息 | search | 不知道哪个网站有信息时使用 |
   136→| 需要全面覆盖整站内容 | crawl | 注意限制深度和页面数，避免 token 溢出 |
   137→| 复杂多源研究任务 | agent | 自主搜索、导航、提取，异步获取结果 |
   138→| 监控页面变更 | monitor | 定时抓取、差异比对、智能判断 |
   139→| 需要与页面交互（点击/输入） | scrape + interact | 先抓取再交互 |
   140→
   141→

1→# Automations Configuration Guide
     2→
     3→This guide explains how to configure automations in Incaier Agent to automate workflows based on events.
     4→
     5→## What Are Automations?
     6→
     7→Automations allow you to trigger actions automatically when specific events occur in Incaier Agent. You can:
     8→- Send prompts to create agent sessions based on events
     9→- Execute prompts on a schedule using cron expressions
    10→- Automate workflows based on permission mode changes, flags, or session status changes
    11→
    12→## automations.json Location
    13→
    14→Automations are configured in `automations.json` at the root of your workspace:
    15→
    16→```
    17→~/.incaier-agent/workspaces/{workspaceId}/automations.json
    18→```
    19→
    20→## Basic Structure
    21→
    22→```json
    23→{
    24→  "version": 2,
    25→  "automations": {
    26→    "EventName": [
    27→      {
    28→        "name": "Optional display name",
    29→        "matcher": "regex-pattern",
    30→        "actions": [
    31→          { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "Check for updates and report status" }
    32→        ]
    33→      }
    34→    ]
    35→  }
    36→}
    37→```
    38→
    39→## Supported Events
    40→
    41→### App Events (可配置)
    42→
    43→以下事件可以在 `automations.json` 中配置：
    44→
    45→| Event | 说明 | Match Value |
    46→|-------|------|-------------|
    47→| `LabelAdd` | 标签已添加（Label added to session） | Label ID (e.g., `bug`, not `Bug`) |
    48→| `LabelRemove` | 标签已移除（Label removed from session） | Label ID (e.g., `bug`, not `Bug`) |
    49→| `LabelConfigChange` | 标签配置变更（Label configuration changed） | Always matches |
    50→| `PermissionModeChange` | 权限模式变更（Permission mode changed） | New mode name |
    51→| `FlagChange` | 会话标记变更（Session flagged/unflagged） | `true` or `false` |
    52→| `SessionStatusChange` | 会话状态变更（Session status changed） | New status (e.g., `done`, `in_progress`) |
    53→| `SchedulerTick` | 定时任务（Runs every minute） | Uses cron matching |
    54→
    55→> **Note:** `TodoStateChange` is a deprecated alias for `SessionStatusChange`. Existing configs using the old name will continue to work but will show a deprecation warning during validation.
    56→
    57→### Agent Events (内部使用，禁止配置)
    58→
    59→> **⚠️ 重要限制：Agent Events 是系统内部使用的事件，不能在 `automations.json` 中配置。配置了也不会生效，验证时会报错。**
    60→>
    61→> 当用户要求创建自动化事件时，只能使用上面的 App Events。如果用户需求无法用 App Events 实现，请告知用户当前不支持该类型的自动化。
    62→
    63→Agent Events 包括：`PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PostToolUseFailure`, `Notification`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `SessionStart`, `SessionEnd`, `Stop`, `SubagentStart`, `SubagentStop`, `PreCompact`, `PermissionRequest`, `Setup`。这些事件由系统内部管理，不对外开放配置。
    64→
    65→## Action Types
    66→
    67→### Prompt Actions
    68→
    69→Send a prompt to Incaier Agent (creates a new session for scheduled prompts).
    70→
    71→```json
    72→{
    73→  "type": "prompt",
    74→  "prompt": "Run the @weather skill and summarize the forecast"
    75→}
    76→```
    77→
    78→| Property | Type | Default | Description |
    79→|----------|------|---------|-------------|
    80→| `type` | `"prompt"` | Required | Action type |
    81→| `prompt` | string | Required | Prompt text to send |
    82→| `llmConnection` | string | Workspace default | LLM connection slug (configured in AI Settings) |
    83→| `model` | string | Workspace default | Model ID for the created session |
    84→
    85→**Features:**
    86→- Use `@mentions` to reference sources or skills
    87→- Environment variables are expanded (e.g., `$CRAFT_LABEL`)
    88→
    89→**LLM Connection & Model:** Optionally specify which AI provider and model to use for the created session. If omitted, the workspace default connection and model are used.
    90→
    91→```json
    92→{
    93→  "type": "prompt",
    94→  "prompt": "Quick code review of recent changes",
    95→  "llmConnection": "my-copilot-connection",
    96→  "model": "gemini-3-pro-preview"
    97→}
    98→```
    99→
   100→The `llmConnection` value is the slug of an LLM connection configured in AI Settings. The `model` value is a model ID supported by the provider. If either is invalid or not found, it gracefully falls back to the workspace default. Both can be used independently or together.
   101→
   102→## Matcher Configuration
   103→
   104→### Display Name
   105→
   106→Use the optional `name` field to give an automation a human-readable display name. If omitted, the name is automatically derived from the first action.
   107→
   108→```json
   109→{
   110→  "name": "Morning Weather Report",
   111→  "cron": "0 8 * * *",
   112→  "actions": [
   113→    { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "Run the @weather skill" }
   114→  ]
   115→}
   116→```
   117→
   118→### Regex Matching (for most events)
   119→
   120→Use the `matcher` field to filter which events trigger your automations:
   121→
   122→```json
   123→{
   124→  "matcher": "^urgent$",
   125→  "actions": [
   126→    { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "An urgent label was added. Review the session and summarise the issue." }
   127→  ]
   128→}
   129→```
   130→
   131→If `matcher` is omitted, the automation triggers for all events of that type.
   132→
   133→### Cron Matching (for SchedulerTick)
   134→
   135→For `SchedulerTick` events, use cron expressions instead of regex:
   136→
   137→```json
   138→{
   139→  "cron": "0 9 * * 1-5",
   140→  "timezone": "America/New_York",
   141→  "actions": [
   142→    { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "Give me a morning briefing" }
   143→  ]
   144→}
   145→```
   146→
   147→**Cron format:** `minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week`
   148→
   149→| Field | Values |
   150→|-------|--------|
   151→| Minute | 0-59 |
   152→| Hour | 0-23 |
   153→| Day of month | 1-31 |
   154→| Month | 1-12 |
   155→| Day of week | 0-6 (0 = Sunday) |
   156→
   157→**Examples:**
   158→- `*/15 * * * *` - Every 15 minutes
   159→- `0 9 * * *` - Daily at 9:00 AM
   160→- `0 9 * * 1-5` - Weekdays at 9:00 AM
   161→- `30 14 1 * *` - 1st of each month at 2:30 PM
   162→
   163→**Timezone:** Use IANA timezone names (e.g., `Europe/Budapest`, `America/New_York`). Defaults to system timezone if not specified.
   164→
   165→## Permission Mode
   166→
   167→The `permissionMode` field controls the permission level of sessions created by prompt actions.
   168→
   169→```json
   170→{
   171→  "cron": "*/10 * * * *",
   172→  "permissionMode": "allow-all",
   173→  "actions": [
   174→    { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "Check system health and log the results" }
   175→  ]
   176→}
   177→```
   178→
   179→**Permission modes:**
   180→- `safe` - Session runs in Explore mode
   181→- `ask` - Session prompts for approval before write operations
   182→- `allow-all` - Session auto-approves all operations (**default for scheduled/unattended tasks**)
   183→
   184→## Labels for Prompt Actions
   185→
   186→> **⚠️ 关键规则：创建或修改 automation 时，`labels` 字段必须使用 `labels/config.json` 中已有的标签 ID。禁止编造不存在的标签！如果没有合适的标签，直接使用 `"other"`。**
   187→
   188→**Mandatory step:** Before writing the `labels` field, you MUST first read `labels/config.json` to get the list of existing label IDs. Then pick the most appropriate one. If none fits, use `"other"`. **NEVER invent a label ID that does not exist in `labels/config.json`** — not even if it seems semantically relevant (e.g., do NOT use `"weather"`, `"news"`, `"report"` unless they actually exist in the config).
   189→
   190→Prompt actions can specify a label that will be applied to the session they create. The label is resolved against the workspace **label library** (`labels/config.json`):
   191→
   192→```json
   193→{
   194→  "cron": "0 9 * * *",
   195→  "labels": ["research"],
   196→  "actions": [
   197→    { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "Give me today's priorities" }
   198→  ]
   199→}
   200→```
   201→
   202→**Label resolution rules:**
   203→
   204→1. **Single label only** — only the first entry in the `labels` array is used; extra entries are ignored
   205→2. **Only use existing labels** — the value is matched against the label library by ID (exact → case-insensitive), then by display name (case-insensitive), then by i18n alias (localized sidebar name → default label ID)
   206→3. **Fallback to "other"** — if no match is found, the session will be assigned the `other`（其他）label. **不会自动创建新标签。**
   207→
   208→**Examples:**
   209→- `["research"]` — matches label with ID `research` in the library
   210→- `["内容"]` — matches default label "Content" via i18n alias (resolves to ID `content`)
   211→- `["研发"]` — matches default label "Development" via i18n alias (resolves to ID `development`)
   212→- `["unknown-label"]` — ❌ no match found → fallback to `other`. **This is wrong — you should have used `"other"` directly!**
   213→
   214→> **Note:** Labels must exist in `labels/config.json` before being referenced. Use the Labels settings page to manage the label library.
   215→
   216→## Complete Examples
   217→
   218→### Daily Weather Report
   219→
   220→```json
   221→{
   222→  "version": 2,
   223→  "automations": {
   224→    "SchedulerTick": [
   225→      {
   226→        "name": "Daily Weather Report",
   227→        "cron": "0 8 * * *",
   228→        "timezone": "Europe/Budapest",
   229→        "labels": ["other"],
   230→        "actions": [
   231→          { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "Run the @weather skill and give me today's forecast" }
   232→        ]
   233→      }
   234→    ]
   235→  }
   236→}
   237→```
   238→
   239→### Log Label Changes
   240→
   241→```json
   242→{
   243→  "version": 2,
   244→  "automations": {
   245→    "LabelAdd": [
   246→      {
   247→        "actions": [
   248→          { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "The label $CRAFT_LABEL was added. Log this change with a timestamp." }
   249→        ]
   250→      }
   251→    ],
   252→    "LabelRemove": [
   253→      {
   254→        "actions": [
   255→          { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "The label $CRAFT_LABEL was removed. Log this change with a timestamp." }
   256→        ]
   257→      }
   258→    ]
   259→  }
   260→}
   261→```
   262→
   263→### Urgent Label Notification
   264→
   265→```json
   266→{
   267→  "version": 2,
   268→  "automations": {
   269→    "LabelAdd": [
   270→      {
   271→        "matcher": "^urgent$",
   272→        "actions": [
   273→          { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "An urgent label was added to this session. Triage the session and summarise what needs immediate attention." }
   274→        ]
   275→      }
   276→    ]
   277→  }
   278→}
   279→```
   280→
   281→### Permission Mode Change Notification
   282→
   283→```json
   284→{
   285→  "version": 2,
   286→  "automations": {
   287→    "PermissionModeChange": [
   288→      {
   289→        "matcher": "allow-all",
   290→        "actions": [
   291→          { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "The permission mode was changed to allow-all. Log the change and note any security implications." }
   292→        ]
   293→      }
   294→    ]
   295→  }
   296→}
   297→```
   298→
   299→## Validation
   300→
   301→Automations are validated when:
   302→1. The workspace is loaded
   303→2. You edit automations.json (via PreToolUse hook)
   304→3. You run `config_validate` with target `automations` or `all`
   305→
   306→**Using config_validate:**
   307→
   308→Ask Incaier Agent to validate your automations configuration:
   309→
   310→```
   311→Validate my automations configuration
   312→```
   313→
   314→Or use the `config_validate` tool directly with `target: "automations"`.
   315→
   316→**Common validation errors:**
   317→- Invalid JSON syntax
   318→- Unknown event names
   319→- Empty actions array
   320→- Invalid cron expression
   321→- Invalid timezone
   322→- Invalid regex pattern
   323→- Potentially unsafe regex patterns (nested quantifiers)
   324→
   325→**To validate manually:**
   326→
   327→```bash
   328→# Check automations.json syntax
   329→cat automations.json | jq .
   330→```
   331→
   332→## Rate Limits
   333→
   334→To protect against runaway automations (e.g., an automation that indirectly triggers itself in a loop), the event bus enforces per-event-type rate limits:
   335→
   336→| Event | Max fires / minute |
   337→|-------|--------------------|
   338→| `SchedulerTick` | 60 (1/sec) |
   339→| All others (`LabelAdd`, `FlagChange`, `PreToolUse`, etc.) | 10 |
   340→
   341→When a limit is hit, further events of that type are **silently dropped** for the remainder of the 60-second window. A warning is logged. The window resets automatically.
   342→
   343→**Example:** If you have a `LabelAdd` task that triggers a prompt which adds a label back to a session, it will fire at most 10 times before being rate-limited — preventing infinite session creation.
   344→
   345→## Troubleshooting
   346→
   347→### Automation not firing
   348→
   349→1. **Check event name** - Must be exact (e.g., `LabelAdd` not `labeladd`)
   350→2. **Check matcher** - Regex must match the event value
   351→3. **Check cron** - For SchedulerTick, verify cron expression with an online tool
   352→4. **Check logs** - Look for `[automations]` or `[Scheduler]` in the logs
   353→
   354→### Prompt not creating session
   355→
   356→1. Check that the prompt is not empty
   357→2. Verify @mentions reference valid sources/skills
   358→
   359→## Best Practices
   360→
   361→1. **Start simple** - Test with a basic prompt before building complex workflows
   362→2. **Use labels** - Tag scheduled sessions with a single label from the label library for easy filtering. **IMPORTANT: Always read `labels/config.json` first to find existing labels — never invent new label IDs.** If no suitable label exists, use `"other"`.
   363→3. **Be specific** - Use matchers to avoid triggering on every event
   364→4. **Test cron** - Use [crontab.guru](https://crontab.guru/) to verify expressions
   365→

    50→| `PermissionModeChange` | 权限模式变更（Permission mode changed） | New mode name |
    51→| `FlagChange` | 会话标记变更（Session flagged/unflagged） | `true` or `false` |
    52→| `SessionStatusChange` | 会话状态变更（Session status changed） | New status (e.g., `done`, `in_progress`) |
    53→| `SchedulerTick` | 定时任务（Runs every minute） | Uses cron matching |
    54→
    55→> **Note:** `TodoStateChange` is a deprecated alias for `SessionStatusChange`. Existing configs using the old name will continue to work but will show a deprecation warning during validation.
    56→
    57→### Agent Events (内部使用，禁止配置)
    58→
    59→> **⚠️ 重要限制：Agent Events 是系统内部使用的事件，不能在 `automations.json` 中配置。配置了也不会生效，验证时会报错。**
    60→>
    61→> 当用户要求创建自动化事件时，只能使用上面的 App Events。如果用户需求无法用 App Events 实现，请告知用户当前不支持该类型的自动化。
    62→
    63→Agent Events 包括：`PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PostToolUseFailure`, `Notification`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `SessionStart`, `SessionEnd`, `Stop`, `SubagentStart`, `SubagentStop`, `PreCompact`, `PermissionRequest`, `Setup`。这些事件由系统内部管理，不对外开放配置。
    64→
    65→## Action Types
    66→
    67→### Prompt Actions
    68→
    69→Send a prompt to Incaier Agent (creates a new session for scheduled prompts).
    70→
    71→```json
    72→{
    73→  "type": "prompt",
    74→  "prompt": "Run the @weather skill and summarize the forecast"
    75→}
    76→```
    77→
    78→| Property | Type | Default | Description |
    79→|----------|------|---------|-------------|
    80→| `type` | `"prompt"` | Required | Action type |
    81→| `prompt` | string | Required | Prompt text to send |
    82→| `llmConnection` | string | Workspace default | LLM connection slug (configured in AI Settings) |
    83→| `model` | string | Workspace default | Model ID for the created session |
    84→
    85→**Features:**
    86→- Use `@mentions` to reference sources or skills
    87→- Environment variables are expanded (e.g., `$CRAFT_LABEL`)
    88→
    89→**LLM Connection & Model:** Optionally specify which AI provider and model to use for the created session. If omitted, the workspace default connection and model are used.
    90→
    91→```json
    92→{
    93→  "type": "prompt",
    94→  "prompt": "Quick code review of recent changes",
    95→  "llmConnection": "my-copilot-connection",
    96→  "model": "gemini-3-pro-preview"
    97→}
    98→```
    99→
   100→The `llmConnection` value is the slug of an LLM connection configured in AI Settings. The `model` value is a model ID supported by the provider. If either is invalid or not found, it gracefully falls back to the workspace default. Both can be used independently or together.
   101→
   102→## Matcher Configuration
   103→
   104→### Display Name
   105→
   106→Use the optional `name` field to give an automation a human-readable display name. If omitted, the name is automatically derived from the first action.
   107→
   108→```json
   109→{
   110→  "name": "Morning Weather Report",
   111→  "cron": "0 8 * * *",
   112→  "actions": [
   113→    { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "Run the @weather skill" }
   114→  ]
   115→}
   116→```
   117→
   118→### Regex Matching (for most events)
   119→
   120→Use the `matcher` field to filter which events trigger your automations:
   121→
   122→```json
   123→{
   124→  "matcher": "^urgent$",
   125→  "actions": [
   126→    { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "An urgent label was added. Review the session and summarise the issue." }
   127→  ]
   128→}
   129→```
   130→
   131→If `matcher` is omitted, the automation triggers for all events of that type.
   132→
   133→### Cron Matching (for SchedulerTick)
   134→
   135→For `SchedulerTick` events, use cron expressions instead of regex:
   136→
   137→```json
   138→{
   139→  "cron": "0 9 * * 1-5",
   140→  "timezone": "America/New_York",
   141→  "actions": [
   142→    { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "Give me a morning briefing" }
   143→  ]
   144→}
   145→```
   146→
   147→**Cron format:** `minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week`
   148→
   149→| Field | Values |
   150→|-------|--------|
   151→| Minute | 0-59 |
   152→| Hour | 0-23 |
   153→| Day of month | 1-31 |
   154→| Month | 1-12 |
   155→| Day of week | 0-6 (0 = Sunday) |
   156→
   157→**Examples:**
   158→- `*/15 * * * *` - Every 15 minutes
   159→- `0 9 * * *` - Daily at 9:00 AM
   160→- `0 9 * * 1-5` - Weekdays at 9:00 AM
   161→- `30 14 1 * *` - 1st of each month at 2:30 PM
   162→
   163→**Timezone:** Use IANA timezone names (e.g., `Europe/Budapest`, `America/New_York`). Defaults to system timezone if not specified.
   164→
   165→## Permission Mode
   166→
   167→The `permissionMode` field controls the permission level of sessions created by prompt actions.
   168→
   169→```json
   170→{
   171→  "cron": "*/10 * * * *",
   172→  "permissionMode": "allow-all",
   173→  "actions": [
   174→    { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "Check system health and log the results" }
   175→  ]
   176→}
   177→```
   178→
   179→**Permission modes:**
   180→- `safe` - Session runs in Explore mode
   181→- `ask` - Session prompts for approval before write operations
   182→- `allow-all` - Session auto-approves all operations (**default for scheduled/unattended tasks**)
   183→
   184→## Labels for Prompt Actions
   185→
   186→> **⚠️ 关键规则：创建或修改 automation 时，`labels` 字段必须使用 `labels/config.json` 中已有的标签 ID。禁止编造不存在的标签！如果没有合适的标签，直接使用 `"other"`。**
   187→
   188→**Mandatory step:** Before writing the `labels` field, you MUST first read `labels/config.json` to get the list of existing label IDs. Then pick the most appropriate one. If none fits, use `"other"`. **NEVER invent a label ID that does not exist in `labels/config.json`** — not even if it seems semantically relevant (e.g., do NOT use `"weather"`, `"news"`, `"report"` unless they actually exist in the config).
   189→
   190→Prompt actions can specify a label that will be applied to the session they create. The label is resolved against the workspace **label library** (`labels/config.json`):
   191→
   192→```json
   193→{
   194→  "cron": "0 9 * * *",
   195→  "labels": ["research"],
   196→  "actions": [
   197→    { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "Give me today's priorities" }
   198→  ]
   199→}
   200→```
   201→
   202→**Label resolution rules:**
   203→
   204→1. **Single label only** — only the first entry in the `labels` array is used; extra entries are ignored
   205→2. **Only use existing labels** — the value is matched against the label library by ID (exact → case-insensitive), then by display name (case-insensitive), then by i18n alias (localized sidebar name → default label ID)
   206→3. **Fallback to "other"** — if no match is found, the session will be assigned the `other`（其他）label. **不会自动创建新标签。**
   207→
   208→**Examples:**
   209→- `["research"]` — matches label with ID `research` in the library
   210→- `["内容"]` — matches default label "Content" via i18n alias (resolves to ID `content`)
   211→- `["研发"]` — matches default label "Development" via i18n alias (resolves to ID `development`)
   212→- `["unknown-label"]` — ❌ no match found → fallback to `other`. **This is wrong — you should have used `"other"` directly!**
   213→
   214→> **Note:** Labels must exist in `labels/config.json` before being referenced. Use the Labels settings page to manage the label library.
   215→
   216→## Complete Examples
   217→
   218→### Daily Weather Report
   219→
   220→```json
   221→{
   222→  "version": 2,
   223→  "automations": {
   224→    "SchedulerTick": [
   225→      {
   226→        "name": "Daily Weather Report",
   227→        "cron": "0 8 * * *",
   228→        "timezone": "Europe/Budapest",
   229→        "labels": ["other"],
   230→        "actions": [
   231→          { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "Run the @weather skill and give me today's forecast" }
   232→        ]
   233→      }
   234→    ]
   235→  }
   236→}
   237→```
   238→
   239→### Log Label Changes
   240→
   241→```json
   242→{
   243→  "version": 2,
   244→  "automations": {
   245→    "LabelAdd": [
   246→      {
   247→        "actions": [
   248→          { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "The label $CRAFT_LABEL was added. Log this change with a timestamp." }
   249→        ]
   250→      }
   251→    ],
   252→    "LabelRemove": [
   253→      {
   254→        "actions": [
   255→          { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "The label $CRAFT_LABEL was removed. Log this change with a timestamp." }
   256→        ]
   257→      }
   258→    ]
   259→  }
   260→}
   261→```
   262→
   263→### Urgent Label Notification
   264→
   265→```json
   266→{
   267→  "version": 2,
   268→  "automations": {
   269→    "LabelAdd": [
   270→      {
   271→        "matcher": "^urgent$",
   272→        "actions": [
   273→          { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "An urgent label was added to this session. Triage the session and summarise what needs immediate attention." }
   274→        ]
   275→      }
   276→    ]
   277→  }
   278→}
   279→```
   280→
   281→### Permission Mode Change Notification
   282→
   283→```json
   284→{
   285→  "version": 2,
   286→  "automations": {
   287→    "PermissionModeChange": [
   288→      {
   289→        "matcher": "allow-all",
   290→        "actions": [
   291→          { "type": "prompt", "prompt": "The permission mode was changed to allow-all. Log the change and note any security implications." }
   292→        ]
   293→      }
   294→    ]
   295→  }
   296→}
   297→```
   298→
   299→## Validation
   300→
   301→Automations are validated when:
   302→1. The workspace is loaded
   303→2. You edit automations.json (via PreToolUse hook)
   304→3. You run `config_validate` with target `automations` or `all`
   305→
   306→**Using config_validate:**
   307→
   308→Ask Incaier Agent to validate your automations configuration:
   309→
   310→```
   311→Validate my automations configuration
   312→```
   313→
   314→Or use the `config_validate` tool directly with `target: "automations"`.
   315→
   316→**Common validation errors:**
   317→- Invalid JSON syntax
   318→- Unknown event names
   319→- Empty actions array
   320→- Invalid cron expression
   321→- Invalid timezone
   322→- Invalid regex pattern
   323→- Potentially unsafe regex patterns (nested quantifiers)
   324→
   325→**To validate manually:**
   326→
   327→```bash
   328→# Check automations.json syntax
   329→cat automations.json | jq .
   330→```
   331→
   332→## Rate Limits
   333→
   334→To protect against runaway automations (e.g., an automation that indirectly triggers itself in a loop), the event bus enforces per-event-type rate limits:
   335→
   336→| Event | Max fires / minute |
   337→|-------|--------------------|
   338→| `SchedulerTick` | 60 (1/sec) |
   339→| All others (`LabelAdd`, `FlagChange`, `PreToolUse`, etc.) | 10 |
   340→
   341→When a limit is hit, further events of that type are **silently dropped** for the remainder of the 60-second window. A warning is logged. The window resets automatically.
   342→
   343→**Example:** If you have a `LabelAdd` task that triggers a prompt which adds a label back to a session, it will fire at most 10 times before being rate-limited — preventing infinite session creation.
   344→
   345→## Troubleshooting
   346→
   347→### Automation not firing
   348→
   349→1. **Check event name** - Must be exact (e.g., `LabelAdd` not `labeladd`)
   350→2. **Check matcher** - Regex must match the event value
   351→3. **Check cron** - For SchedulerTick, verify cron expression with an online tool
   352→4. **Check logs** - Look for `[automations]` or `[Scheduler]` in the logs
   353→
   354→### Prompt not creating session
   355→
   356→1. Check that the prompt is not empty
   357→2. Verify @mentions reference valid sources/skills
   358→
   359→## Best Practices
   360→
   361→1. **Start simple** - Test with a basic prompt before building complex workflows
   362→2. **Use labels** - Tag scheduled sessions with a single label from the label library for easy filtering. **IMPORTANT: Always read `labels/config.json` first to find existing labels — never invent new label IDs.** If no suitable label exists, use `"other"`.
   363→3. **Be specific** - Use matchers to avoid triggering on every event
   364→4. **Test cron** - Use [crontab.guru](https://crontab.guru/) to verify expressions

You can reach larger items in a quick and easy manner, saving you the need to open both doors every time.\n\n[LEARN MORE](https://www.westinghouse.com.au/fridges-and-freezers/fridges/features/)\n\nFreshSeal™ Easy Glide Crispers\n------------------------------\n\nFreshSeal crispers with automatic humidity control give you the flexibility to look after your fruit and vegetables the right way. Designed with your comfort in mind, the easy glide crisper bins open effortlessly and provide easy access even when they’re full.\n\n[Learn more](https://www.westinghouse.com.au/fridges-and-freezers/fridges/features/)\n\n![FreshSeal™ Easy Glide Crispers](https://www.westinghouse.com.au/siteassets/place-holder.png)\n\n![Filtered Water Dispenser](https://www.westinghouse.com.au/siteassets/place-holder.png)\n\nFiltered Water Dispenser\n------------------------\n\nThe Westinghouse French Door Fridge with ice and water helps keep your family healthy and hydrated. With easy access to filtered water from the slimline in-door water dispenser, no one will need to go thirsty again.\n\n[LEARN MORE](https://www.westinghouse.com.au/unglossy/articles/pure-water-peace-of-mind/)\n\nFridge to Freezer, with a touch of a button.\n--------------------------------------------\n\nWith the widest temperature range from -23C to +7C our FlexSpace Fully Convertible Drawer adapts to your needs with a touch of a button\\*. With 5 predefined settings, chill your drinks, freeze your meat or store your deli snacks, helping with the fridge and freezer shuffle. \\*within 2 hours\n\n[Learn more](https://www.westinghouse.com.au/fridges-and-freezers/fridges/features/)\n\n![Fridge to Freezer](https://www.westinghouse.com.au/siteassets/place-holder.png)\n\n![Stylish Design](https://www.westinghouse.com.au/siteassets/place-holder.png)\n\nStylish Design\n--------------\n\nCrafted with ultra-modern flat doors, elegant handle options and your choice of Dark or Natural Real Stainless Steel or white your fridge will be the centrepiece of your kitchen. (Options vary by model)\n\n[LEARN MORE](https://www.westinghouse.com.au/fridges-and-freezers/fridges/features/)\n\nSlide Back and Flip Up Shelves\n------------------------------\n\nThe flexibility to slide back or flip up some of the fridge shelving makes fitting those extra tall items or large platters a piece of cake.\n\n[LEARN MORE](https://www.westinghouse.com.au/fridges-and-freezers/fridges/features/)\n\n![Slide Back and Flip Up Shelves](https://www.westinghouse.com.au/siteassets/place-holder.png)\n\nFeatured Products\n-----------------\n\nWe aren’t about fancy features, just beautiful designs that work, created with the freshest produce in mind.
